Table 2: Ablation study of Moirai 2.0 design choices. Starting from the Moirai 1.0 followed by a decoder-only variant using the original GIFT-Eval pretraining and distributional loss (v0), new pretraining corpus (v1), quantile loss (v2), autoregressive quantile decoding (v3), random masking (v4), and multi-token prediction (v5). The final Moirai 2.0 additionally replaces the linear projection with a residual block, achieving the best overall results.
